items.context: I've got a question, what kind of video game would you want to play togeather with your dad? 🎮 (little hint for my next art post tomorrow 😏)
items.text: Co-op games are a great pick for this. It Takes Two is built for exactly two players, and Overcooked 2 is chaotic fun for any age mix. Looking forward to the art!
